A '''grave''' was the [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter's]] [[Burial/Legends|tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]]. After the Daughter sacrificed her life, the [[Father (Mortis)/Legends|Father]] buried her body here with the [[Dagger of Mortis/Legends|Dagger of Mortis]] laid upon her breast.

It was later visited by the [[Son/Legends|Son]], who would also be the grave's final visitor, who wanted to retrieve the dagger. There, he admitted that he truly loved his sister. The grave had a roll away door. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] visited the Father where he asked his advice on what he should do about the Son.
